---
title: "Call Stack Sandbox"
subtitle: "Watch each function call land on the stack, and stay greyed out once it returns"
---

Instead of tree this visualises recursion as stack. the call which returns does not disappear but gets greyed out (note - feels a bit confusing but disappearing also feels confusing, not sure which is better). shows an arrow from the call to the result.

```{=html}
<div class="panel-grid panel-grid--stack">
  <div class="panel">
    <div id="stack-editor"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="panel">
    <div id="stack-viz"></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { PythonEditorInput } from "./js/utils/python-editor-input.js";
import { mountCallStackViz, callStackStarterCode } from "./js/call-stack-viz.js";

stackEditor = PythonEditorInput.mountPlayable(
  document.querySelector("#stack-editor"),
  {
    heading: "Python",
    defaultCode: callStackStarterCode,
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
stackViz = mountCallStackViz(document.querySelector("#stack-viz"), {
  editor: stackEditor,
})
```
